summary: The trace reveals the existing clinical-lab-harmonization skill failed on a hepatic panel task due to: (1) missing conversion rules for hepatic analytes (bilirubin, albumin, hemoglobin, etc.), (2) incorrect glucose conversion logic where SI values (mmol/L) are numerically smaller than conventional (mg/dL), and (3) CRLF line endings in output despite explicit guidance. Updates expand analyte coverage, clarify the glucose special case, and strengthen line ending enforcement.
